risk_register.description: Silent plan-semantics drift: implementation artifacts or code changes effectively alter the meaning of upstream R#/AT#/O#/K# without an explicit ChangeRequest + governed decision, violating no-scope-expansion constraints.

mitigation.text: Add deterministic semantic-drift gates: (1) require explicit mapping table from each change/patchset to referenced R#/AT#/O#/K# IDs; (2) validator rejects any patchset/decision_record that introduces new requirements/acceptance criteria not present in plan_package_final.json unless a ChangeRequest artifact is present and approved per policy; (3) enforce reviewer role emits findings-only and cannot author ChangeRequest/patchsets.

risk_register.description: Audit spine breakage: missing/overwritten run_manifest, non-append-only event_log, or unversioned artifacts leads to irreproducible outcomes and invalidates evidence pointers.

mitigation.text: Enforce immutability/append-only at storage interface; validator requires: run_manifest immutable hash recorded at first emission, event_log monotonic sequence numbers, artifact_ref uniqueness + content hashes; stage transitions blocked if any required audit artifacts are missing or mutated.

risk_register.description: Evidence pointer non-compliance: artifacts embed freeform citations (paths, prose, or non-RFC6901 references) causing unverifiable traceability and broken downstream consumption.

mitigation.text: Add a strict evidence-reference linter validator: only allow evidence pointer objects {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note}; reject any nonconforming reference fields; require trace_report.json to enumerate all evidence pointers and validate pointers resolve against versioned JSON artifacts.

risk_register.description: Patchset path abuse: diff-only patchsets modify forbidden/protected paths or perform high-risk operations (e.g., build scripts, auth, deployment) outside policy, leading to security/compliance incidents.

mitigation.text: Introduce deterministic forbidden-path/protected-path enforcement at patch-apply time (reject before apply) using repo_context.json patterns; require HITL for any patch touching protected paths or release/deploy configuration; enforce operation caps and file-type restrictions for patchsets.

risk_register.description: Nondeterministic tool executions (flaky tests/builds) cause inconsistent gate outcomes, leading to incorrect freezes or endless repair loops.

mitigation.text: Define deterministic retry/quarantine rules: fixed retry budget, fixed backoff schedule, record all attempts in event_log, classify failures as flaky after consistent pattern thresholds, and block freeze unless tests pass under the deterministic policy; add stabilization stage with bounded changes and reroute/HITL thresholds.

risk_register.description: Secrets leakage into canonical artifacts or workspace (event log, patches, snapshots, context packs), violating secrets policy and creating durable compromise.

mitigation.text: Mandatory secrets scanning at each checkpoint and before freeze across: patchsets, logs, repo_snapshot, context_packs, stage_handoffs; deterministic redaction/blocking rules (block freeze and require remediation patchset); deny network exfiltration by default; ensure scanners’ findings are stored as structured artifacts without embedding secrets.

risk_register.description: Workspace integrity failure: canonical vs non-canonical separation is violated (e.g., canonical artifacts overwritten in-place, or non-canonical notes treated as sources of truth), breaking deterministic resume and traceability.

mitigation.text: Enforce workspace namespace policy: canonical paths append-only/versioned; non-canonical paths write-once per stage with explicit provenance; workspace_index.json required to enumerate all items with type/version/provenance and immutability flags; validator rejects unindexed items or canonical overwrites.

risk_register.description: Context pack overflow or under-selection: bounded context packs omit critical artifacts or exceed size limits, causing incorrect decisions/patches or truncation-driven errors.

mitigation.text: Deterministic context-pack selection rules with priorities (latest stage_handoff, work_plan, relevant patchsets, validation outputs, decision_record draft), plus explicit byte/token budgets; validator checks pack completeness against required sets per stage and rejects out-of-bounds packs.

risk_register.description: Role separation failure: writer/reviewer/judge boundaries blur (e.g., reviewers generating patches, judges editing work plans), undermining independence and governance requirements.

mitigation.text: Orchestrator-enforced output-type allowlists by role: reviewers may only emit findings artifacts; judges may only emit decision artifacts; patchers may only emit patchset artifacts; enforce multi-vendor routing and record model/vendor in run_manifest for each stage output.

risk_register.description: JSON Patch misuse: repairs apply RFC6902 patches that touch forbidden paths, exceed op caps, or introduce schema-invalid states, leading to corrupted canonical artifacts.

mitigation.text: Validator enforces: (1) patch op count caps, (2) forbidden JSON Pointer path rules per artifact type, (3) schema revalidation after patch application, (4) deterministic patch ordering and tie-breakers; reject nonconforming patches before apply.

risk_register.description: Integration conflicts: multiple patchsets or parallel pods produce overlapping diffs causing merge conflicts, inconsistent base/head commits, or partial application that breaks reproducibility.

mitigation.text: Require explicit base_commit in each patchset; deterministic apply order rules; if conflicts occur beyond defined thresholds, block and trigger reroute to an integration stage or HITL; emit integration_report artifact describing conflict classification and chosen deterministic resolution path.

risk_register.description: Acceptance-test trace mismatch: test_results cannot be deterministically mapped to AT# acceptance tests, breaking trace completeness gates and weakening validation credibility.

mitigation.text: Define required AT# linkage fields in test metadata; validator requires that each AT# has either a passing mapped test or an explicit, approved waiver/ChangeRequest; trace_report must enumerate AT#→test evidence pointers.

risk_register.description: Release artifact unsafe/incorrect: release_bundle produced without passing all gates, includes unreviewed binaries, or references non-reproducible build steps.

mitigation.text: Freeze gate requires reproducible build recipe captured in structured artifact; release_bundle allowed only after all validators pass; require signed/hashed build outputs and provenance record; disallow network-dependent build steps unless explicitly allowlisted and captured in dependency policy artifacts.

risk_register.description: Supply-chain/network risk: package manager operations or network access pull unpinned dependencies or leak information, undermining reproducibility and security.

mitigation.text: Default network deny; allow network only in explicitly designated stages with allowlisted domains and deterministic lockfile requirements; validator checks dependency changes are pinned and justified with evidence pointers; require offline cache/mirror strategy artifact when network is enabled.

risk_register.description: Over-broad refactors: patchsets attempt repo-wide rewrites contrary to bounded-change constraints, increasing failure rate and review burden.

mitigation.text: Define patchset size limits (files changed, diff hunks, risk-weighted thresholds) and require decomposition into staged patchsets; validator rejects oversized patchsets unless approved via HITL with rationale captured in decision_record.

risk_register.description: Checkpoint/resume inconsistency: missing or incomplete stage_handoff artifacts cause inability to resume deterministically, leading to duplicated work or inconsistent outcomes.

mitigation.text: Require stage_handoff emission at every checkpoint boundary with mandatory pointers to work_plan, current patchsets, validation outputs, and pending blockers; validator blocks stage transition if handoff missing or pointers do not resolve.

risk_register.description: Decision integrity risk: judge outputs or decision_record include conclusions without linked evidence pointers, allowing ungrounded approvals/waivers.

mitigation.text: Decision validator: every approval/waiver must include evidence pointers to passing gate artifacts or an explicit policy exception with HITL signoff; disallow freeze if any decision clause lacks evidence pointers.

risk_register.description: Misconfigured tool permissions: stages accidentally permit destructive commands, broad filesystem writes, or unbounded artifact mutation, enabling accidental damage or policy bypass.

mitigation.text: Machine-enforced tool permission matrix per stage with deny-by-default; continuous validation of effective permissions (policy-as-data) and audit logging of tool invocations; HITL required to expand permissions beyond baseline.

restrictions.notes: Ingest plan_package_final.json and required context artifacts; no code changes.

hitl_triggers: Schema validation failures that cannot be repaired via RFC6902 without changing semantics

restrictions.notes: Draft work_plan, proposed patchsets (as artifacts), and required mappings; no direct repo mutation.

hitl_triggers: Proposed work requires changing plan semantics (must raise ChangeRequest)
Proposed patchsets touch protected/forbidden paths per repo_context

restrictions.notes: Only apply diff-only patchsets against declared base_commit; direct edits prohibited.

hitl_triggers: Patch application conflict beyond deterministic thresholds
Any attempted modification of forbidden/protected paths

restrictions.notes: Execute deterministic validators and emit structured results.

hitl_triggers: Secrets detected in any artifact/workspace output
Flaky failure classification exceeds retry/quarantine policy thresholds
Validator outputs indicate policy violations requiring exception

restrictions.notes: Reviewers are findings-only; they do not emit canonical writing/patch artifacts.

hitl_triggers: Reviewer identifies high-risk area requiring manual security/compliance approval
Reviewer flags ambiguity that implies upstream plan defect (reroute to Planning Council)

restrictions.notes: Judge emits decisions/waivers only; no patch authoring.

hitl_triggers: Any waiver of a gate (tests/build/security/trace) is requested
Any permission expansion beyond baseline is requested

restrictions.notes: Emit Implementation Freeze Bundle only when validators confirm all gates; otherwise block.

hitl_triggers: Attempt to freeze with any failing gate
Missing required artifacts in the freeze bundle list

when_to_interrupt: Any proposed ChangeRequest (plan-semantics change) or any evidence of silent scope expansion
Any attempt to modify forbidden/protected paths or perform high-risk repo operations (auth, deploy, credential handling)
Any secrets detection event in artifacts/workspace/logs or suspected exfiltration vector
Any waiver request for required freeze gates (build/test/lint/typecheck/security/trace/reproducibility/workspace integrity)
Any tool-permission expansion beyond baseline (e.g., enabling network, broad filesystem writes, executing undeclared entrypoints)
Any nondeterminism/flakiness exceeding deterministic retry/quarantine policy thresholds
Any merge/integration conflict beyond deterministic resolution thresholds
approval_roles: Repo Owner/Maintainer (for protected paths and release approval)

taxonomy_categories: Operational limits (budgets, op caps) and escalation pathways
